title: Dev server reloads every open page when anyone writes under notes/ (Playwright traces), making e2e flaky
steps: 1. Run `pnpm exec vite --port 5305 --strictPort`. 2. Open the app. 3. While another agent or a Playwright run writes trace artifacts under notes/tmp-*/ (or any .html/.css/.svg under the project), watch the page.
expected: Files under notes/ and test-results/ are not watched. The app keeps its in-memory state and tests are deterministic.
actual: The vite log showed 235 '(client) page reload notes/tmp-exe/results/.playwright-artifacts-0/traces/resources/*.html|css|svg' events during my run. Open pages fully reload in the middle of a test, which breaks it with 'Execution context was destroyed' or 'element was detached' errors and wipes unsaved UI state. This made several of my runs fail randomly until I used a scratch config with server.watch.ignored.
